report.summary: Logins failed after the OTP step due to JWT validation errors caused by time drift on node pool np-3 following an infrastructure node image update.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Node Clock Drift on Node Pool np-3

supporting.note: Node pool np-3 image updated at 13:36, switching time sync to systemd-timesyncd.
Kubernetes logs show clock offset warnings exceeding 5s on node np-3-a1 starting at 13:39:27.
auth-service error logs show JWT validation failure due to tokens issued in the future (iat skew) on pod auth-service-6f7d-k2x9p on node np-3-a1 starting at 13:40:09.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Delayed Bug in auth-service Release v7.2.0

supporting.note: auth-service v7.2.0 deployed two days prior.

contradicting.note: Errors specifically name clock/iat skew and tie directly to node np-3-a1 rather than code logic.

facts.text: About a third of logins failed with errors starting at 2026-10-16T13:40:00+00:00 in auth-service and mobile-bff.
Node pool np-3 image was updated at 2026-10-16T13:36:00+00:00, changing time synchronization from chrony to systemd-timesyncd.
Kubernetes reported node np-3-a1 clock offset exceeding 5s threshold starting at 2026-10-16T13:39:27+00:00.
auth-service pods running on node np-3-a1 rejected JWTs with token issued in the future starting at 2026-10-16T13:40:09+00:00.

assumptions: Pods scheduled on other nodes or node pools without clock skew continue to validate tokens successfully, accounting for the ~33% failure rate matching traffic on node np-3-a1.
evidence_gaps: Exact pod distribution across node pools to verify whether exactly 1/3 of traffic landed on np-3-a1.

timeline.event: Node pool np-3 node image updated, switching time sync from chrony to systemd-timesyncd
Kubernetes logs first clock offset warning of ~99s on node np-3-a1
auth-service and mobile-bff error rates spike
auth-service logs first JWT validation failure due to future iat skew on pod auth-service-6f7d-k2x9p

recommended_actions.action: Reschedule or restart pods on node np-3-a1 or force systemd-timesyncd resynchronization on node pool np-3
recommended_actions.rationale: Corrects the ~95s clock offset causing JWT validation failures.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate why systemd-timesyncd failed to synchronize time correctly on node image 2026.10.3
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future regressions during node pool updates.

recommended_actions.action: Add monitoring and alerts for node clock drift exceeding 5 seconds across all Kubernetes node pools
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures rapid detection of time sync failures before customer impact occurs.
